name: The Lost Delinquents of Rollings High
source:
You play as Marty Greenwood, a high school senior just about to graduate from Rollings High School. Marty lives in the peaceful mountain town of "Franks Hollow" and this is his final week of senior year. Prom and exams are coming up, along with a host of school events, the final week promises to be brimming with High school mischief and memories! But there's something terribly wrong in Franks Hollow....will Marty and his friends be able to discover what it is before prom and graduation?

[From Steam]
translation:
你将扮演即将从罗林斯高中毕业的高三学生马蒂·格林伍德。他住在宁静的山间小镇弗兰克斯霍洛，如今正迎来高中生涯的最后一周。毕业舞会、考试与各种校园活动接踵而至，这一周注定充满校园里的恶作剧与回忆！然而，弗兰克斯霍洛出了极其严重的问题……马蒂和朋友们能否赶在毕业舞会与毕业典礼之前，查明究竟发生了什么？

[摘自Steam]
